title: Test-machine host
statement: Given three finite Turing machines $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$ over the Boolean alphabet, the test-machine host is a multi-tape Turing machine with $3+2k_V+2k_I+2k_P$ work tapes and states consisting of a test phase paired with a state for that phase. Its initial state is the anchor phase with its unique state; its phase machines are the test-phase machines, and transitions between phases follow the test-phase redirects.
hypotheses_covered: three finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
